lista.descripcion: Aprende Peque · Series Infantiles
The Squirrels are transported into the future, where they encounter a robot version of Duggee as well as a few other interesting changes to the clubhouse.
The Squirrels think about life's big questions, helping Tino the Artistic Mouse escape a crisis of confidence.
Duggee and the Squirrels are baking. But if there are six bakers and only one pie, how will they all get to eat? Duggee shows the Squirrels how to divide things up.
The Squirrels are curious about what happened 'a long, long time ago'. So Duggee takes them on a trip through time, where they meet a host of characters from the past.
The Squirrels learn about different types of art and what inspires them while preparing their own pieces for Tino the Artistic Mouse's Woodland Biennale.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The Crazy Golf Badge
lista.descripcion: Duggee and the Squirrels practice their golf swing in some interesting conditions in pursuit of the ultimate prize - a round of milkshakes.
Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

lista.titulo: Numberblocks - Fun Times One Times Table
lista.descripcion: One goes in search of the legendary One Times Table. Sing along and learn the One Times Table with the Numberblocks.

lista.titulo: Numberblocks - The Many Friends of Twenty
lista.descripcion: Twenty enters the Pattern Palace to find out who his Twenty-friends are. Learn about number bonds to 20 with the Numberblocks.
The Numberblocks compete in the finals of the Ten-vaulting contest. Learn about adding past ten with the Numberblocks.
What if Two was the first Numberblock? Imagine that! Learn about even numbers up to 20 with the Numberblocks.
A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One!

lista.titulo: Peg + Gato - Follow The Bouncing Ball
lista.descripcion: Cat chases his favorite ball as it bounces through 10 different worlds to 10 different beats.

The characters have prepared an exhibit that displays different art genres, such as painting, sculpture, and photography. Pato plays the role of an art critic and visits the exhibit, but there is nothing he likes there. The rest of the characters ask him to show his artistic skills, and it is then Pato realizes that making art is not so easy.
Pocoyó y Pato se encuentran unos contenedores de reciclaje.

Pocoyo, Elly and Pato are in the garden, where they have planted tomatoes, carrots and lettuce. When it is time to pick and eat them, the vegetables suddenly start to move by themselves. They finally catch them and discover why they were moving.
When Pocoyo pretends to be sick to get out of tidying up, Elly becomes a nurse along with her assistant Pato to take care of him.
Pocoyo and Pato go out fishing together in a lake with their bait being Caterpillar, but when she befriends a fish, they both play pranks on the boys, angering them.

El zoo del jardín de Bluey alberga animales maravillosos, como el gran gorila azul que es su padre. Sin embargo, cuando atrapa a Bingo y escapa, Bluey, como cuidadora, debe capturar al animal salvaje.

¡Mamá y papá van a vivir una aventura y llevan a las traviesas niñas como mochilas! Disfrutar de las vistas y de la comida de los puestos… ¡Qué divertido es ser mochilero! Hasta que pierden el pasaporte.
Princesas, caballos y varitas mágicas. Bluey y Chloe pueden jugar en el papel que quieran en esta aventura en la que salvan el reino del patio de la Reina Codiciosa.
Bluey se está divirtiendo imitando todo lo que hace y dice su padre, pero el juego se interrumpe por algo serio. Encuentra a un periquito herido y tienen que irse urgentemente al veterinario.
Sigue las aventuras de un cachorro de Blue Heeler que vive con su papá, su madre y su hermanita.

El grupo de juego de Bluey está en peligro, porque el hospital de bebés de Indy es incompatible con los caballeros y dragones de Rusty. Sin embargo, al explicar sus razones, descubren que ambos juegos tienen mucho en común.
May the rabbit agrees to look after Baba while Oona goes fishing, but her plans are derailed when Baba finds a hibernating hedgehog.

Fixies try their best to avoid people. They are afraid that people, having learned about Fixies, will begin to catch them and keep them in captivity, as pets. And even worse, they will drag their own scientific laboratories, and there they will study under a microscope or set experiments on Fixies, or people will take them and stop caring for machines and devices, deciding that Fixies will do all the work for them. And if they themselves, people will not protect their equipment, repair it, clean it, then it will begin to break so that no Fixies will help. In a word, hiding from people, Fixies act wisely.

After driving away Simka and Nolik by acting rude to them, Tom Thomas soon learns a lesson about friendship and playing nice when he finds himself in need of their help when his electric train set mysteriously breaks.

Simka and Nolik realize that they can fix a toy car with a small part from inside the dishwasher. But to get the dishwasher working again they'll need that same part from the TV. Now, how can they fix that TV?

Estando de acampada, Bluey hace un nuevo amigo que se llama Jean-Luc. Puede que Bluey no hable su idioma, pero dan con la forma de entenderse a través del juego y cazando a papá, que hace de jabalí.

Daniel and Mom Tiger talk, draw and play about some of the things that Dr. Anna will use - a stethoscope, an otoscope, a scale and more. With Tigey and his homemade doctor book in hand, Daniel learns that it also helps to talk with Dr. Anna about what will happen.

lista.descripcion: Mom and Dad Tiger are going out for the evening, and Prince Tuesday comes to be Daniel’s babysitter. As Daniel gets ready for bed, he misses his Mom and Dad. But Prince Tuesday reminds him that his parents will be back soon. When Tigey goes missing right before bedtime, Daniel learns what a grr-ific babysitter Prince Tuesday is. And his trust continues to build when he sees that his parents do come back, just as they promised.

Cleo, Colitas y Cuquín van al bosque, pero pronto descubren que algo va mal. ¡El bosque está muy enfermo! ¿Descubrirán por qué el lago está seco y lo solucionarán?
Cleo y Cuquín organizan un festejo para recibir el verano. Pelusín descubre que lo mejor de la fiesta será el baile, pero le da vergüenza bailar. ¿Lograrán que se anime?
